annotations.title: List the org's custom data tables

description: List your organization's custom data tables with their column schemas. Custom tables are Final's built-in, station-syncing database — data written on one station is automatically synced to every other station running the flow, and keeps working OFFLINE at the point of sale. They are the ONLY sanctioned persistence for generated apps (browser storage is per-device, never syncs, and is wiped on real Render terminals — validate_flow rejects it). Call this before create_custom_table to reuse an existing table instead of duplicating one. For NEW functionality, check search_blueprints before designing tables — a vetted blueprint may already provide the feature, and a selfPersisting blueprint's tables may NOT appear in this list (often extension-owned, resolved by name at runtime): their absence is never a reason to create lookalikes. Generated code reads/writes rows at runtime via renderClient.getCustomTableData / upsertCustomTableData (ground with lookup_command_frame).
